test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Call it a day

options.text: To decide to stop doing something

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To decide to stop doing something.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Call it a day"** means to decide to stop doing something, usually because you have done enough or because it is time to stop. (आज के लिए काम समाप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example:** After working on the project for several hours, we decided to call it a day.
 
 
 
• **"Call it a day"** refers to the decision to end work or an activity for the rest of the day. (आज का काम ख़त्म करना)
 
 
• **Example:** It's already 8 PM, let's call it a day and continue tomorrow.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To decide to stop doing something.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To stop worrying over something** (किसी चीज़ के बारे में चिंता करना बंद करना): To cease being anxious about an issue.

 
 
• **Example:** You should stop worrying over the exam results and relax.
 
 
 
• **To reach the destination** (गंतव्य तक पहुंचना): To arrive at the place you were traveling to.
 
 
• **Example:** We finally reached our destination after a long journey.
 
 
 
• **To avoid meeting someone** (किसी से मिलने से बचना): To deliberately not meet or interact with someone.
 
 
• **Example:** He tried to avoid meeting his ex-girlfriend at the party.
 
 

7d:Te07,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
